text:
Alex M: Quick heads-up — Seahorse Labs (HSM + SI) wants to do a joint marketplace tile + integration guide. Core scope: SAML SSO (SP-initiated + IdP metadata), SCIM with group filters, and PKCS#11 BYOK for secrets. Need owners and a short test plan by EOD Fri. @Tina Zhou @Diego R

Tina Zhou: I'm in. Proposed owners: Tina = security/BYOK runbook, Diego = SCIM mapping & tests, Alex = marketplace copy + partner comms. Quick asks from my side: partner must provide HSM attestation (FIPS/SOC2) and a module manifest for PKCS#11. Also need audit event schema for key imports/rotations.

Diego R: For SCIM, we require group-scoped sync. Example minimal create payload we use in staging:
```
POST /scim/v2/Users
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "seahorse-test@redwood.ai",
  "meta": {"resourceType":"User"},
  "groups": [{"display":"eng-nimbus","value":"eng-nimbus"}]
}
```
We'll enforce a filter param like `filter=groups.value sw \"seahorse-\"` so partners can't pull whole directories. I'll add delta sync test cases to the draft.

Alex M: SAML notes: partner asked for SP metadata URL. Share this example and mention cert rotation steps and clock skew troubleshooting:
```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID=\"https://console.redwood.ai/saml/metadata\">
  <SPSSODescriptor>... cert, AssertionConsumerService ...</SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
Include test accounts and an IdP-initiated and SP-initiated checklist.

Tina Zhou: BYOK runbook outline: (1) exchange PKCS#11 module info and slot config, (2) establish secure channel (mutual TLS) for import, (3) import wrapped key and run encrypt/decrypt sample, (4) rotate and replay consumers. Rollback: failover to Redwood-managed KMS and rotate consumer keys. Also require proof of key escrow policies and retention.

partners-bot: Draft playbook created at https://docs.internal/partners/seahorse/onboard (edit: Alex,Tina,Diego). Preflight CI queued: scim-smoke, saml-meta-check.

Diego R: Acceptance test I propose: provision user via SCIM with group seahorse-ops -> verify entitlement appears in app -> call protected endpoint. If any step fails, block GA.

Alex M: Timeline: draft by Fri EOD, internal review Mon, partner review Tue, soft launch in 3 weeks. I'll own embargo + press contacts. Ping me if anyone needs a hand with legal logo assets. :shipit: :lock:
